name: lockdown-workflows-and-agents
goal: Lockdown the primary workflow (plan → session plans + inbox → local/global context), lockdown the session plan format for strict agent adherence, and audit all agent files and agent specs in opencode.json.
scopeIn: docs/ (new workflow spec and schema doc files)
invariants: HeadWrench delegation model is sacred — never writes code or does deep research directly
Session plan is the source of truth
Checkpoint is mandatory at end of every subtask
gitWorkflow: Conventional commits per checkpoint (feat/fix/docs/chore). WIP commits at each checkpoint: 'wip: subtask-NN <description>'.

subtasks.name: bootstrap
subtasks.description: Session bootstrap — create directory, index.md, spec.json

subtasks.name: audit-agent-files
subtasks.description: Audit all agent files in opencode/agents/ and opencode/commands/

subtasks.name: write-schema-doc
subtasks.description: Write session plan format schema doc + embed instructions in headwrench.md

subtasks.name: apply-agent-fixes
subtasks.description: [GATE] Apply fixes from agent file audit

subtasks.name: final-review
subtasks.description: Final review, conventional commit, close session
